title: Galexme's Mods
description: The modpack used in the incredible youtuber Galexme's videos.
body:
# Galexme's Vanilla+
![Thumbnail with in-game screenshot (Character added after)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c739d7b677d2a21fbd6e30a33756e8c48713d9ec_0.webp)
**Adds vanilla plus features such as shaders, ambient sounds, and performance mods, nothing heavy.**
### 
## Just minimalist features:

- Fresh animations
- Connected textures
- Photon shaders
- etc.

## Then the performance mods:

- Sodium
- Entity Culling
- Noisium
- etc.

**For more showcase of the modpack, watch my survival series here!**
